retention_tricks: Rapid Cuts: Quick scene changes to maintain visual dynamism.
Text Overlays: Reinforce key points visually, especially useful for sound-off viewing.
Sound Design: Use upbeat music, sound effects, and voice-overs to keep energy high.
Cliffhangers/Open Loops: Introduce a question or mystery early and resolve it near the end.
Visual Pacing: Vary camera angles, zoom levels, and subject movement to prevent monotony.
Direct Addressing: Speak directly to the viewer, asking rhetorical questions or making eye contact (if applicable).
